subject: Post-call: sequence-length & output footprint — pricing alignment
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Ben Saunders <ben@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: sequence-length & output footprint — pricing alignment

Thanks again for taking the time today, Ben — quick recap and the items we said we'd follow up on. High level summary first: Ellum's primary flows are (1) clinician summarization of multi-note patient history, (2) patient-facing Q&A (short prompts, short replies), and (3) nightly analytics batch scoring. These map to three sequence-length buckets that will drive cost: short (~1–2k tokens), medium (~6–12k tokens), and long (>40k tokens) for archival/analytics work.

Key numbers from the call (please confirm if I got any of these wrong):
- Monthly active users: ~25k clinicians, ~80k patient sessions/month.
- Avg prompt tokens (clinician): ~180 tokens (structured prompt + notes snippet).
- Avg completion tokens (clinician summary): ~650 tokens.
- Avg prompt tokens (patient Q&A): ~40 tokens; completion ~120 tokens.
- Nightly batch jobs: ~5k records at ~45k prompt tokens + 2k completion tokens each (one-off heavy runs).

Pricing & unit-econ asks we discussed:
- Target unit cost target you mentioned: $/1M tokens target between $350–$900 depending on SLA and window size.
- Expected steady-state monthly token volume estimate: 50M–180M tokens (scale ramp to 180M if pilot succeeds).

Immediate asks / next steps (action owners):
1) Diego: send concise token-mix deck + recommended model/window mapping for pilot (attached).
2) Ben: confirm the nightly batch count and whether all records need full 128k window or if a sampled subset is sufficient.
3) Marissa/Karthik: prepare a pricing sheet with per-1M token tiers for 8k / 32k / 128k model variants and expected cost per completed clinical summarization at each tier.

Attachment: ellum-token-mix-deck.pdf (includes per-flow token breakdown, model suggestions: rwd-8k, rwd-32k, rwd-128k; and a sample cost calc at $/1M token bands).

Thanks — goal is to have the pilot pricing + scope doc to you by EOD tomorrow so we can lock materials for procurement.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ellum-token-mix-deck.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Saunders <ben@ellumhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel@ellumhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T18:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: sequence-length & output footprint — pricing alignment

Thanks Diego — this is great, and you captured the flows accurately. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Nightly batch: it's closer to 4,800 records (not 5k) — most of them do need the full historical context (~45k tokens) for the scoring model. We can sample 10% for quick experiments but pilot should assume full-window runs.
- Monthly volume: 60M tokens is our conservative starting projection; if the pilot shows latency + quality we expect to hit ~140–160M/month within 6 months.
- Target $/1M: the finance sponsor indicated a hard ceiling of $750/1M for the pilot; they'd prefer ~$500/1M if we can justify the quality delta at that price.

I'll review the deck and confirm by EOD tomorrow. Can we also get an RTT (latency) estimate for the clinician summarization path on rwd-32k vs rwd-128k? That will influence whether we do synchronous API or async batch for production.

-Ben
Director, Data Science — Ellum Health
[No attachments]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Ben Saunders <ben@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: sequence-length & output footprint — pricing alignment

Appreciate the clarifications, Ben — updated plan and quick answers below.

1) Nightly batch: noted 4,800 records at ~45k tokens. We'll price the pilot assuming full-window runs and show a sampled-option alternative in the deck.

2) Latency: rough SLOs based on our perf profiles (subject to final infra choice):
- rwd-32k synchronous summarization (typical clinician request): median p95 ~420ms / p99 ~1.2s depending on batching and prefix caching.
- rwd-128k synchronous (if we had to): median p95 ~950ms / p99 ~2.5s. For guaranteed sub-second p95 we typically recommend rwd-32k with prefix caching and short completion token limits (<=700 tokens).

3) Pricing snapshot (high-level, illustrative for pilot):
- 8k variant: $420 / 1M tokens
- 32k variant: $560 / 1M tokens
- 128k variant: $820 / 1M tokens
These reflect reserved-pool assumptions for a 3-month pilot commit and include modest QoS/priority. We'll break out a spot/hosted comparison in the formal sheet.

4) Example per-summary math (clinician flow):
- Avg prompt 180 + avg completion 650 = 830 tokens total -> at 60M tokens/month that's ~72k calls/month -> rough monthly cost at rwd-32k pricing: (60M/1M)*$560 = $33,600.

Next steps: Marissa and Karthik will create the tiered pricing sheet and a short ROI slide for procurement. I'll update the deck with the latency table and the two pricing scenarios (conservative 60M tokens and optimistic 150M tokens). Expect updated materials in your Drive link by 16:00 PT today.

If that works, let's tentatively lock a follow-up call Thurs 11:00 PT to review pricing and procurement ask. I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ellum-token-mix-deck.pdf (updated)]
